goal: prove or falsify a commercially permissive rotated-detector runtime path before training or migration

compatibility_fix.trigger: first probe reached native inference but NumPy 2.2.6 was ABI-incompatible with the Torch 2.0.1/MMCV compiled stack
compatibility_fix.change: constrain NumPy to 1.26.4 for every install and pin OpenCV 4.10.0.84 inside the same NumPy-1-compatible envelope

probe_stages: verify exact source commit and Apache license
load official RTMDet-R Tiny DOTA checkpoint
run real inference on MMRotate official demo image
serialize native prediction geometry and version hashes
non_goals: no accuracy comparison with Cycle 11 yet
no claim of ONNX deployability until a separate export probe passes
commercial_policy: Promotion requires permissive source/model licensing to remain documented and a later ONNX/runtime parity gate to pass.
